text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, after finishing some shopping
with Sounds of Earth—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the fun, fun lottery!
Anyone and everyone, come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rattle, rattle, rattle—)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
――! The crisp, pleasant sound
of dry wood... This sound is――

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: VIBRASLAAAAP!!!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ――Doesn't look like it, though, hehe.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Pardon me, I couldn't contain my appassionato and made a little joke.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: From the sound of it, is that the lottery bell?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"This too is vivo...
A lively tone, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Sì! If possible, I'd love to hear that sound up close.
choice_data_list: Alright, go give it a try!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I have a single raffle ticket I got while shopping earlier.
I hand it over to her.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Grazie, my kind friend!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: I will never let your kindness go to waste.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: I promise you that your joyful cheers upon receiving the prize shall also echo across this sky!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Sounds of Earth turned the raffle wheel handle with a flourish!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
ââ!!
Brillllllllante!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I got it, Trainer!!
A hot springs trip, huh... Bene!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Hmm, what should I do...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
A violin is a must, right?
Plus maracas, castanets...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
A piano might be tough.
No, if it's an electronic piano, maybe—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer, what will you do?
choice_data_list: Huh... What do you mean, "what will I do"?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Items for our trip, of course!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Is there an instrument you'd like to play?
Just say the word, and I'll have it ready for you.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, a session played alongside you in the heart of nature...
Just imagining it—
Fortissssimooo!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The words "with you" caught my attention.
Could it be—
choice_data_list: Huh, you mean you're going with me!?
Wait, you mean you're coming with me?!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Sì!
Though, only if that is what you wish, of course.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I... would love to go. And I want to play
an ensemble with just the two of us.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
How about it, my direttore?
What do you say to a reward for our future selves?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
How about it, my direttrice?
What do you say to a reward for our future selves?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In her smile, I could see kindness and consideration toward me,
as well as her own iron will.
In that case—
choice_data_list: Got it, I'll think about what to bring

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Grazie!
Fufu, I'm looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
————
Oh, right, since we have this chance, that song too—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"*Ahem*. Hehe, just a whimsical tremolo.
Don't mind me."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we decided to entrust
the reward to our future selves—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—!
A novel symphonia...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: "Look at this, Trainer! Look at this distinct design!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
While the overall composition is scherzando,
the towering carrot exudes
a distinctly grandioso aura as well...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: And—sembra buono!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: I'd certainly love to take my time savoring it while admiring the view…… Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
So let us turn that deliciousness
into a brand-new melodía!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I brought home some hamburg steak and we ate together.
Moved by how delicious it was, Sounds of Earth
played a new melody for me.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
So many...! Ciao,
my adorable carotine!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Hm, hmm...♪
I can hear it—their lovely chorus.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Well then, let's sing together on our way back!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"LaLaLa~~La~~♪
LaLaLa~~La~~♪ Come on, you sing too!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hesitated for a moment, but seeing Sounds of Earth's
joyful expression, my voice naturally
broke out into song.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Nice, that's the spirit! Now then, our choir
shall put on an open-air concert all the way back to the academy!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Arms full of carrots, the two of us
walked the road back to the academy,
cheerfully singing along the way.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Mezzo-piano...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry. As a small token of apology,
please take this."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sounds of Earth slumped her shoulders.
Yet it wasn't her fault.
Is there anything I can do for her—
choice_data_list: Then, shall we cook something delicious together?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ――! Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you...
...my amoroso.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After returning to the academy, we made a salad together.
It was simple, but its taste felt comforting and warm.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Ah... Pianissimo...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry I wasn't able
to bring a smile to your face...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I swear to you, if there is a next time,
I will make you animato without fail—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Poco a poco... Until then, I must practice even harder...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sounds of Earth looked downcast
at the disappointing result...
